messages:
Maya P.: Quick sync — launch metrics landed. Two levers in front of us: fix the 3 identified regressions (login edge, streaming stalls, embedding mismatch) vs shipping the small UX enhancement pack (improved prompt UI + inline examples). Need to pick fast for a 2-week follow-up sprint. Thoughts?
Omar (Eng): TL;DR: regressions cause real user drops. Fixes are infra+model routing + small decoder bug. Estimated dev effort: 7 dev-weeks total but we can stagger.
Lina (SRE): +1 on regressions. Streaming stalls correlate with higher tail latency on GPU pool b. I can hotfix routing to route affected tenants off that pool within a day.
Priya (Support): Customer-facing severity: login edge is high (3 enterprise customers blocked), embedding mismatch causing wrong reranking for 2 customers (medium). UX asks are more numerous but lower pain.
Ben (Sales): Sales asks for UX pack — helps demos and conversion, but customers on contracts want reliability fixes first. If we delay fixes >2 weeks they ask for credits.
Kevin (Design): UX pack is mostly polish: 3 screens + microcopy. Design effort ~3 designer-days, dev ~2 dev-weeks for front-end. Works well as canary feature behind flag.
Maya P.: Proposal: immediate triage -> short hotfix for login + routing rollback (1 week), then soft-canary deploy UX pack to a subset while we schedule embedding fix. That balances revenue risk and demo momentum.
Omar (Eng): Plan works if we reserve one engineer on embedding fix parallel to hotfix. Embedding mismatch looks like a tokenizer edge-case between v1/v2 models — likely 4 engineer-days to remediate and test.
Lina (SRE): I'll prepare a routing policy: route tenant IDs starting with 0-4 to pool a, 5-9 to pool c. I can push that tomorrow with feature-flagged rollout.
Priya (Support): Can we get an official customer note template? I can draft a "temporary mitigation" email for the three affected accounts.
Maya P.: Yes — Priya draft, send to me + Ben for review. Also: escalate billing credit recs if they ask; we'll decide after hotfix.
Ben (Sales): I'll prep talking points. If we ship UX canary, we can offer preview to smaller accounts as a trade.
Kevin (Design): For the canary, I'll hand off annotated specs by EOD. Need front-end tickets and API schema stable.
Omar (Eng): Heads up: embedding fix touches offline evals. I'll queue a small eval run: 
```python evals/run_embedding_check.py --model v2 --dataset regression_set.csv
```
Should complete in ~2 hours once queued.
deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-hotfix -> staging (job 78214), started by Lina at 2145680000
Lina (SRE): Staging looks good. If no regressions in 30m I'll promote to canary.
Maya P.: Decision summary: 1) Hotfix routing + login patch -> ship within 48h. 2) Parallel small embedding fix queued. 3) UX pack shipped as feature-flagged canary next week if routing stable. Owners: Lina (routing), Omar (embedding + auth patch), Kevin (design), Priya/Ben (customer comms). I'll update roadmap doc and milestone tickets. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya (Support): I'll drop draft note in #help and ping Maya.
Omar (Eng): I'll create the embedding PR now and add test matrix.
Ben (Sales): Looping in account execs.
Lina (SRE): Promoting to canary in 10m.
Maya P.: Let's reconvene after canary for go/no-go. Meeting if needed Friday 10am.
